@source: sohk

@default_cost: 25
@description:
 [Vocational] A guide makes his living leading people from one place to
 another. Usually, a guide knows a lot about the outdoors and the region in
 which he operates. Most guides can be trusted to take their charges to their
 destination faithfully, but some are dishonest, and seek to make an easy
 profit by preying upon the ignorance of others. Time to Acquire: 30 months.
 Starting Money: normal.
